# FactSmith

> FactSmith is a data architecture practice with its own product inside. It puts Claude and Copilot dashboards on business data that is modelled, agreed and proven, and designs the warehouses underneath.

Services: a fixed-price Claude Dashboards quick-start (one warehouse connected, starter dashboards, team trained, answers proven against the client's own golden questions), trusted numbers for Claude and Copilot (a governed layer of agreed business meaning under AI dashboards), and senior data architecture on contract. FactSmith Ask is the product inside: a governed answer layer over Kimball-style dimensional warehouses that runs on the client's own network; a gateway that serves its facts to Claude is in development.

Contact: hello@factsmith.co.za

Sitemap: https://www.factsmith.co.za/sitemap.xml

## Custom dashboards (examples on sample data)

- [Custom dashboards](https://www.factsmith.co.za/custom-dashboards/): bespoke dashboards FactSmith builds on a client's own data; three live examples
- [Response Live](https://www.factsmith.co.za/custom-dashboards/response-live/): armed response times by area, live call-outs, plain-English questions
- [Fleet Live](https://www.factsmith.co.za/custom-dashboards/fleet-live/): vacuum-tanker fleet on one map: status, tank level, pump hours, fuel
- [Armed Response Management](https://www.factsmith.co.za/custom-dashboards/armed-response/): Claude Dashboard on a Kimball model: response, staffing and money tabs with slicers and drill-down
